purpose: Remove visible hand/arm pixels and reconstruct a plausible document/background counterfactual as though the human limb were absent.

historical_primary_candidate.arm_labels: upper/lower arms via model labels, fallback ids 3 and 4
historical_primary_candidate.mask_union: SCHP arm mask union MediaPipe hand mask
historical_primary_candidate.compositing: Gaussian-feathered alpha blend into untouched original

historical_reference_full_corpus.method: LRASPP MobileNetV3-Large person segmentation -> threshold 0.25 -> component cleanup -> 7x7 dilation -> TELEA radius 5
historical_reference_full_corpus.role: historical corroboration/reference only; not preferred because it segments generic person pixels rather than explicit arms plus hands

stage_1_resurrection.population: existing fixed 48-image ST context-only perturbation-development sample
stage_1_resurrection.goal: reproduce exact historical SCHP+MediaPipe+TELEA outputs and generate before/after QA previews

criteria: absence of major seams or flat-polygon artifacts

stage_2_validation_if_stage_1_passes.population: frozen deterministic 100-image ST context-only PoC sample
stage_2_validation_if_stage_1_passes.algorithm: same exact frozen historical pipeline unless a specific Stage-1 defect required one documented minimal engineering correction

improvement_rule: Do not invent alternative V3/V4 pipelines. Only make a minimal, explicitly documented correction if Stage 1 reveals a concrete defect. Never use classifier performance to choose the correction.
full_scale_rule: Proceed to frozen-model evaluation only after Stage 1 and Stage 2 visual/preservation gates pass. Otherwise report PoC failure and stop.
interpretation_limit: A performance change is evidence about sensitivity to the frozen hand/arm-removal counterfactual, not proof of causality or perfect reconstruction.
